palette: deep warehouse green + inventory cream + cold-chain aqua + lien copper + alert magenta
typography: industrial inventory labels with oversized operative verbs and compact custody notes
composition: a three-action loading bay, a perishable-goods conversion channel, and a secured-rights custody shell
surface: warehouse floor markings, flat storage silhouettes, preservation seals, and no table-like shelving
motion: ordinary assets enter one of three restraint actions, perishables convert into preserved value, and security rights remain outside the restraint shell
transition: the inventory seal persists while the asset changes from ordinary object to perishable value to secured property
